description: This PHP file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.5.0. It includes database schema updates such as creating tables and adding columns related to OAuth and REST API usage, as well as inserting or updating OAuth client data.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class that updates the database schema for OrangeHRM version 4.5.0, adding OAuth and REST API related tables and data.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs schema updates such as creating tables and adding columns if they do not exist, and inserts default OAuth client data.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of this migration, which is '4.5'.
